item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00230","case1_error":"Equates current practice with past half-practice and asserts P=2P, then unjustifiably concludes two days.","case2_error":"Doubles only the first day's shells instead of the combined first two days.","reason":"Case 1 conflates practice totals at different times and makes invalid deductions; case 2 omits part of the specified doubling base.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00231","case1_error":"Lists unsupported incorrect final numbers after correctly specifying the calculation; the total should be 3,240 minutes.","case2_error":"Returns daily earnings of $144 after correctly calculating the requested five-day earnings of $720.","reason":"Case 1 supplies incorrect numbers without showing their calculation; case 2 explicitly answers the wrong time-period quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00232","case1_error":"Reverses the stated chronology, labels 143 cm the final length, and includes the seven-centimeter cut; the question also ambiguously identifies boards.","case2_error":"Divides the original daily page count by the new reading time, incorrectly changing the reading rate from 50 to 20 pages/hour.","reason":"The wood question inconsistently describes which boards are longer and cut, making the intended pre-cut quantity materially ambiguous. Case 2 clearly mixes original output with new time.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00233","case1_error":"States an unsupported total of 120 after correct partial calculations, without calculating Michael's or Joyce's durations; the correct total is 76.","case2_error":"States an unsupported 80 weeks after correctly specifying the formulas, which yield four weeks.","reason":"Both append incorrect final numbers without showing a calculation that produces them; neither supports diagnosing a particular arithmetic mistake.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00234","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 21, but the complete derivation correctly obtains 29 yellow marbles.","case2_error":"Miscounts vacation days, includes weekends as practice days, and incorrectly evaluates 10,000/2,888 as 34.72 instead of approximately 3.46.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared or different mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
